name: fit-score
useFor: Use the bar in tables and Compare headers, the chip on cards and the ring on the parcel record. Pass `value` (null when never screened) and `loading` while a screen runs. Levels are words, never colors: Strong fit (80 and up), Moderate (60 to 79), Weak (under 60).
constraints: A percent sign; it is a score
source: Not in Figma yet; built from Ticks, Tag and the Dial's geometry
title: Fit score
description: How well a site meets the buyer's requirements, 0 to 100: a tick bar, a chip or a ring, with the level in words.
